sol.quote: the skill extraction stage only uses user queries rather than model responses, i.e., it learns from but does not use as extraction evidence.
We design skills as editable and versioned artifacts, which improves transparency, controllability, and long term maintainability compared with implicit memory or policy based approaches.
Designed as a model-agnostic plugin layer, it is compatible with existing LLMs and introduces a standardized skill representation for sharing and transfer across agents, users, and tasks.
Instead of storing only dialogue snippets or preference records, AutoSkill abstracts reusable behaviors from user interactions and crystallizes them into explicit skill artifacts.

A newly extracted candidate is not directly written into the skill bank. Instead, the system first retrieves the most similar existing skills and uses them as local evidence for maintenance decisions.
